sources.claim: The standard gamepad axis enum contains left X/Y, right X/Y, left trigger and right trigger in this order.
The standard gamepad button enum contains 26 positional and extended button slots in the adopted order.
A zero axis value is also a valid centered value, so value zero cannot represent channel absence by itself.
GR00T N1.7 uses fixed maximum state/action widths, an embodiment ID and an action mask; its action loss is multiplied by that mask.

adopted_design.tensor_order: six SDL3 axes followed by twenty-six SDL3 buttons
adopted_design.pair_button: excluded because it manages device connectivity rather than game control

project_local_choices: SDL3 defines separate axis and button enums; concatenating axes before buttons is this project's versioned tensor layout.
Device IDs are stable only within this contract and are not SDL numeric identifiers.
Task masks are supplied by the consuming task and must be a subset of device or simulator availability.
